revisionStages.title: Revision of Knowledge
revisionStages.description: Review your Study Text and Pocket Notes chapter-by-chapter across all 5 syllabus domains before tackling timed exam-kit questions.

revisionStages.title: Question Practice (Detailed Plan)
revisionStages.description: Work systematically through Kaplan’s recommended Section A, Section B, and Section C questions by topic. Observe the strict 1.8 minutes per mark timing rule.

revisionStages.title: Final Mock Exam
revisionStages.description: Sit the full 3-hour CBE Specimen Exam (Section A Q1–15, Section B Glam Co / Chair Co / Hi Life Co, Section C Carad Co / Thatcher International Park) under strict exam conditions.

detailedPlan.topic: Information, Technologies & Systems for Organisational Performance
detailedPlan.chapters: Study Text Ch 1–3 · Pocket Notes Ch 1–3
detailedPlan.tutorGuidance: Questions on systems, information security (ACCURATE, TPS/MIS/EIS/ERP), and big data (4Vs) prepare you well for Section A and potential Section B/C narratives.

detailedPlan.chapters: Study Text Ch 4–8 · Pocket Notes Ch 4–8
detailedPlan.tutorGuidance: Compare full absorption costing vs ABC; master target cost gaps, full life-cycle costing, Throughput Accounting Ratio (TPAR), and environmental cost categories (Hansen & Mendoza).

detailedPlan.chapters: Study Text Ch 9–14 · Pocket Notes Ch 9–14
detailedPlan.tutorGuidance: Drill relevant cash flows, multi-product breakeven/C/S ratios, linear programming shadow prices & slack, demand equation P = a − bQ, make-or-buy, and risk criteria (maximax, maximin, minimax regret, EV).

detailedPlan.chapters: Study Text Ch 15–19 · Pocket Notes Ch 15–19
detailedPlan.tutorGuidance: Practice rolling budgets (Static Co), learning curves (Henry Company), regression (Venhosp), materials mix & yield (Kappa Co), sales mix & quantity, and planning vs operational variances.

detailedPlan.chapters: Study Text Ch 20–23 · Pocket Notes Ch 20–23
detailedPlan.tutorGuidance: Master ROI vs RI, transfer pricing ranges (min = MC + lost contribution; max = external market price), Balanced Scorecard, Fitzgerald & Moon Building Block model, and NFP Value For Money (3Es: Economy, Efficiency, Effectiveness).

examTechniqueTips: Observe the strict 1.8 minutes per mark rule: 36 minutes for a 20-mark Section C question.
Always show clear workings inside the CBE spreadsheet using cell references and formulas (e.g. =SUM, =AVERAGE) to protect method marks.
In Section C narrative parts, plan headings in the Scratchpad first, then address the exact company scenario rather than writing generic textbook points.
Do not leave any OTQ blank in Section A or B — there is no negative marking.
Use Flag for Review on time-consuming quantitative OTQs and return once easier conceptual marks are banked.
